cinderfall.incomplete: Every ally who can hear the caster gains +2 circumstance to their next attack/save until the caster's next turn. Same "no companion, bare ally bonus" gap as eyes-up/on-my-mark. This is also a named "Redline" card -- the class's own glossary (site/data/cards/classes/classes.deadhand.json) defines Redline as spending Tally in a lump by definition, so the card is Tally-gated even though its own description doesn't restate an explicit numeric cost -- Deadhand's Tally is entirely homebrew with zero schema footprint anywhere in this corpus.
